signals.title: El bitcoin cae hasta los 68 000 $ a medida que la euforia por la salida a bolsa de Anthropic se suma a la inestabilidad del mercado
signals.summary: Los analistas no encuentran vínculo directo entre Nvidia y la caída de Bitcoin; atribuyen la caída al traslado de capital de inversores a Anthropic y a una tendencia general de aversión al riesgo.
signals.title_orig: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
signals.summary_orig: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

signals.title: Perplexity lanza Decider v1.3: los modelos de decisión de pesos abiertos añaden Locate
signals.summary: Perplexity lanza Decider v1.3 y Flash v1.3, modelos de decisión de peso abierto que devuelven probabilidades y añaden la función Locate, alcanzando 91,6 % de precisión media en 63 tareas de clasificación.
signals.title_orig: Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate
signals.summary_orig: Perplexity Decider v1.3 and Flash v1.3 are open-weight decision models that return probabilities, not text. Version 1.3 adds Locate for span extraction and reports 91.6% mean accuracy on 63 query-classification tasks. The post Perplexity Releases Decider v1.3: Open-Weight Decision Models Add Locate appeared first on MarkTechPost .

signals.title: El bitcoin se dirige a su sexta pérdida semanal a medida que se acerca la esperada salida a bolsa de Anthropic

signals.title_orig: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
signals.summary_orig: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

signals.title_orig: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash
signals.summary_orig: Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast agentic model with a 1M-token window, 4 thinking levels and $1.50/$7.50 pricing. Google reports a 51 Artificial Analysis score and 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1. The post Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 2.5x Faster Than Gemini 3.8 Flash appeared first on MarkTechPost .
